stage: Training-only refinement of the retained-method real adapter before any new-branch validation inference.
reason: The preceding fixed empirical-range/convex correction selected mix0 using training data, so no gain and all artifacts are kept. Do not force an empirical band to fit the known validation case. Replace that unsuccessful training-only recovery head with an explicitly trained operating-state verifier.
reuse: Keep the parent real-trained whole-event verifier, its62 training labels and original50-feature numerical lineage, and the retained local-rescue/original-positive-preservation chain. Reuse the identical native CPOP curve; original production weights/physical heads untouched.
new_recovery_features: Only2 fixed features per original observation: absolute power/current distance to the recorded preceding operating level divided by the largest signed excursion already observed in that channel before this point, with descriptive-scale floors. Running past excursions prevent a slow initial ramp being called a return merely because a future larger peak exists.
return_candidate: After the detected onset, both power and current must move back from an already observed signed excursion by at least max(.03kW,2scaleP)/max(.15A,2scaleI). This is a directional phase check, with no minimum duration or point removal. The2-feature model then verifies return to the previous operating state rather than equality to a fixed old power value.
training_labels: Use22 existing training recovery endpoints as positive native observations. Prefix return candidates strictly before the lower recovery bracket are negatives, not points inside that uncertain bracket; never mark all points after an endpoint positive because subsequent events may exist. Known no-recovery/censored positive training windows supply negative return candidates; ambiguous no-unique-recovery windows do not. User-group4fold OOF and per-window balanced sample weights prevent point rows from the same history crossing folds or long windows dominating.
model: Standard2-feature StandardScaler+LogisticRegression C1, max_iter2000, no deep model/extra feature search. Select only threshold.5/.7/.9 using OOF trajectory recovery error with180s missing penalty; prefer no extra spurious recovery versus CPOP on training censored cases. Freeze model/source before validation. Original estimate remains fallback if no accepted candidate, and presence/onset are unchanged by this recovery layer.
evaluation: Original32 validation windows are already-seen development labels, not a blind test. Compare the real-adapted retained chain against originalCPOP/LABS under the same input and label policy. If improved, choose32 additional validation-role windows prospectively by pilot/time/hash, no overlap with previous windows, review raw data before running model outputs. This is development confirmation with provisional single-assistant labels, not final-test or field-gold certification.
limits: This ports the learned evidence/calibration architecture and shared numeric feature block to available observed boundary targets; it does not port unsupported old C/L effective durations or claim old frozen simulation weights valid.
